item.title: AI model releases: 12–16 October 2026
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon and Muse Wonder expand the API choices. Muse Spark Open and NVIDIA’s Nemotron releases bring new deployment options. A review of the week so far, with access and costs checked.

item.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt: model size and local deployment
item.description: NVIDIA’s Bolt compresses Super VL for local deployment. A smaller model footprint changes the hardware calculation; it does not settle the bill.
